block.prompt: Read Leo's blog post. Find THREE things Leo DID last weekend (past) and THREE of his PLANS (future). Write them in the table.
block.answer_key: Past (any three): went into the city; watched a football match; (our team) won 2–1; ate fish and chips; felt tired but happy. Future (any three): (my family) is going to visit my grandparents; we will go hiking in the mountains; I hope the weather will be sunny.
block.acceptable_reasoning: Je drei passende Beispiele genügen; die genaue Formulierung ist frei.
watch_outs: Ziel ist, die Zeitformen bewusst zu machen: Vergangenheit (went, watched, won, ate, felt) gegenüber Zukunft (is going to, will, hope).
Der Satz "I am reading" (present continuous) gehört zu KEINER der beiden Spalten — gute Gelegenheit, Gegenwart von Vergangenheit und Zukunft abzugrenzen.
Unregelmäßige Vergangenheitsformen (went, ate, won) hier schon einsammeln und an der Tafel sichern.
